claudeCodeVersion: 2.1.309 (P2 ran 2.1.308; the CLI in the container is recorded per execution in setup.json)
effort: CLAUDE_EFFORT=medium and MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=31999, passed explicitly (P2 inherited the same values)
condition: K1 isolated-cli: one headless `claude -p` process per turn; a fresh session and configuration directory per execution in every arm; arm E continues its own session (--resume) for its implement and repair turns

environment.mode: allowlist (env -i): PATH, HOME, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, TERM, IS_SANDBOX=1 (the container's own marker; the CLI refuses bypassPermissions as root without it; amendment A1), ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, CLAUDE_EFFORT, MAX_THINKING_TOKENS, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, DOTNET_ROOT, NUGET_PACKAGES, DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT, DOTNET_NOLOGO, MSBUILDDISABLENODEREUSE, DOTNET_CLI_USE_MSBUILD_SERVER, UseSharedCompilation
environment.rationale: P2 removed a fixed list of orchestrator variables. The P3 orchestrator's environment carries many more (memory, session ingress, skill and plugin sync, artifact tools, git credential injection, the egress proxy). An allowlist keeps all of them, and network egress, away from every agent in every arm.
